We've Got Your Information. Here's What We Do From Here.

Thank you. Your free consultation request is confirmed. A member of the Inquiry Removal team will reach out within 24 hours to schedule your 15-minute credit review.

Step 1, Within 24 hours

We reach out by email or phone, whichever you prefer, to confirm your consultation time. If you'd rather skip the wait, call us directly at 602-377-6626.

Step 2, At Your Consultation (15 Minutes)

We pull up your Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion reports together. We walk through every hard inquiry, identify every one that qualifies for removal, total them across all three bureaus, and tell you exactly which plan fits your situation.

Step 3, If You Decide to Move Forward

Custom dispute letters are built and submitted to all three bureaus within 24 hours of signup. Then we handle everything. You monitor your score as the removals come through.
